name: hq
description: Org agent hub: unified Claude Code skills, plugins, and workflow playbooks.

plugins.name: hq-core
plugins.description: Mandatory core: onboarding, workflow recommendations, code-review standards, commit conventions, and the SDD pipeline.

plugins.name: codebase-toolkit
plugins.description: Optional: architecture deepening, skill authoring, issue triage, zoom-out context, and throwaway prototyping.

plugins.name: chatbot-toolkit
plugins.description: Optional: build a full-stack, Claude-powered Meta messaging bot (WhatsApp + Instagram).

plugins.name: dispatch-kit
plugins.description: Optional: dispatch autonomous Claude workers into a pool of git worktrees from inside a session — the runtime tail of the SDD pipeline.

plugins.name: frontend-toolkit
plugins.description: Optional: cross-cutting frontend craft skills for React-family web + React Native — components, state, styling, a11y, performance, and testing.
